# sauth_subscription_list (Resource)

The subscription_list records of the service, through its state import and export



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `app` (String) app id
- `key` (String) the record key, its identity in the service and in references
- `title` (String) list title

### Optional

- `cadence_seconds` (Number) seconds between releases
- `description` (String) list description
- `feed_url` (String) rss feed the list follows
- `language` (String) feed language
- `name` (String) list name a client subscribes by
- `site_url` (String) site the feed belongs to
